hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while :; do if [ -f "$d/repos.json" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/guard.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/scripts/guard.py" --agent codex; fi; if [ "$d" = / ]; then exit 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done
d="$PWD"; while :; do if [ -f "$d/repos.json" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/session-sync.sh" ]; then exec bash "$d/scripts/session-sync.sh"; fi; if [ "$d" = / ]; then exit 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done
